subject: general
question: April 2023, the Maharashtra government has approved how much percentage of reservation for Divyang employees in promotions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**0.04**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Maharashtra government has approved **0.04** (or 4%) percentage of reservation for Divyang employees in promotions as of April 2023.
 
• This decision aims to promote inclusivity and provide equal opportunities for Divyang (differently-abled) employees in the state government.
 
• The reservation policy covers various departments and positions within the state government, ensuring that differently-abled employees receive adequate representation in higher posts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Reservation for differently-abled individuals is part of the broader affirmative action policies to address historical disadvantages and discrimination faced by these groups.
 
• In India, the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, mandates various provisions to empower and protect the rights of differently-abled individuals.
 
• The Act also provides for reservation in education, employment, and other spheres to ensure their full and effective participation and inclusion in society.
 
• Such measures are crucial in fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of their abilities, can contribute to and benefit from economic and social development.
